text:
sanjay: Noticing a pileup in eu-west3 - large attach queue and NVMe tails. GPU pods Pending (Attach) for ~18m. Queue jumped from 1 -> 110.
maria_ops: I see high io_wait on gnode-scratch-eu-west3-a. Any recent job bursts or cron changes?
opsbot: ALERT: janitor-cleaner concurrency=68 on gnode-scratch-eu-west3-a (12:08 UTC); io_wait=72% ; GPU-attach autoscaler paused.
leo: We pushed janitor v2 last night to improve cleanup throughput. Did we re-enable strict batching?
taylor: Yep, v2 removed stagger and increased batch_size to 256 for rm+fsync. It helped throughput but might be too aggressive for small blocks.
sanjay: Logs from one host:
```
JanitorWorker[pid=3129] start /scratch/tmp
fsync batches=6 batch_size=256 small_writes/sec ~9k
iostat: %util=99.1 r/s=3 w/s=2300 await=13.8
kernel: attach_tmo=120s triggered
```
maria_ops: That write profile will saturate nvme lanes and spike write amplification. Options: throttle janitor with ionice/cgroups, reintroduce stagger, or offload GPU traffic temporarily.
leo: Quick mitigation: reduce janitor concurrency to 3 and run ionice -c2 -n7. I can push a hotfix in 2 mins.
taylor: Also propose a scheduler safety gate: if attach_pending>50 then pause janitor scheduling for 30m. Prevents cascading backlogs.
opsbot: NOTE: SMART attr delta: nvme0n1 reallocated increased on 3 nodes within 48h. Flagging for potential wear acceleration.
maria_ops: If drives are degrading we should divert new GPU requests to eu-west3-dedicated for now. It's a cost bump but preserves SLA.
sanjay: Agreed. Can we set routing policy to favor dedicated for 20m and throttle janitor rollout? Also start eviction of the 3 flagged hosts from GPU pool.
leo: I'll push routing rule and enact node exclusion. Patching janitor concurrency now.
taylor: After immediate mitigation, let's schedule a postmortem: gather iostat, janitor logs, k8s attach traces, and wear histograms. Also revert or tune v2 stagger logic before rolling further.
sanjay: Who owns the postmortem? I'd like eng-infra + eng-runtime on it. Maria, can you own execution and timeline?
maria_ops: I can run the remediation and lead the postmortem. Will create a runbook update with guardrails (concurrency defaults, attach-queue safety gate, ionice by default).
opsbot: ACTION: route-change applied; janitor concurrency patched -> 3; safety gate enabled (attach_threshold=50; pause=1800s).
leo: Monitoring: attach_pending dropping back to single digits, io_wait falling to ~18% on patched nodes. Keep an eye for SMART regressions.
taylor: We'll also add a cost note: routing to dedicated for 20m estimated ~$2.2k in incremental infra cost. Ops OK with that?
maria_ops: Approve — customer uptime > cost. I'll log chargeback.
sanjay: Thanks all. Follow-up: snapshot wear-metrics and open ticket for drive replacement if SMART continues to climb.
leo: copying logs to incident ticket now.
opsbot: INCIDENT: eu-west3 nvme-tail mitigated (status=stabilized).
